## Why

Every colour, type size, space, radius and motion value on the public
surface was hand-scattered across `epistemic.css`, `islands.css`,
`curate.css` and literal palettes inside the map/network islands —
including a raspberry incompleteness banner that read "a count of gaps"
as a disagreement (K14 NEW-2) and an orange map palette that forked the
served `style.json`'s blue. This row lands K14 UXK14-1: `tokens.css`
owns every value, component styles consume `var(--sig-*)`, a lint makes
a bypass a build failure, and the palette's claims (contrast, monotone
ordinal ramp, reserved-hue discipline, non-green) are proven by tests,
never trusted on faith (§3.1).

## What ships

- **`web/src/styles/tokens.css`** — the whole token layer:
  - **Type (SIG-UI-148):** the 8-step scale `--sig-step--2`…`--sig-step-5`
    (13 px floor; steps 4/5 responsive clamps), paired
    `--sig-leading-*`, `--sig-measure: 68ch`, `--sig-content: 72rem`.
  - **Colour:** the neutral set (`--sig-bg/surface/surface-2/rule/
    rule-strong/ink/ink-muted/link`) in light + a *chosen* dark set
    under `prefers-color-scheme: dark` (SIG-UI-147 posture — never an
    inversion), print forcing light, `color-scheme: light dark`.
  - **Reserved hues (K14 NEW-2):** raspberry `--sig-epi-disagree-*`
    (contested/unresolved only), amber `--sig-epi-provisional-*` (the
    unevaluated-method state only), blue for links + the single
    categorical `--sig-data-1` plus the sequential `--sig-data-seq-*`
    ramp. No epistemic token in the 75–165° green band (SIG-UI-006).
  - **The slate support ramp (K14 NEW-3):** `--sig-epi-support-4…1`,
    single hue ~215°, strictly monotone lightness, darker = more
    support; UNSUPPORTED a neutral zero state, not a ramp step.
  - **Space/radius/motion:** the 4 px `--sig-space-1…9` ramp, the
    4/8/pill radius set + 1/2 px borders, `--sig-motion-1/2`
    (120/160 ms) zeroed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
  - **Font:** vendored Public Sans Variable
    (`src/assets/fonts/public-sans-latin-wght-normal.woff2`, 26,832 B,
    sha256-verified from `@fontsource-variable/public-sans` 5.3.0,
    OFL-1.1 at `src/assets/fonts/OFL.txt`), `font-display: optional` +
    metric-matched fallback — D-K14-3 as recommended.
- **Migration (SIG-UI-146):** `epistemic.css` is restated on tokens
  (imports `tokens.css`; every literal is a `var(--sig-*)`), `islands.css`
  and `curate.css` likewise; every legacy `--sig-*`/`--sig-epi-*` name is
  kept as a `var()` alias — no consumer renamed, back-compat holds.
- **Neutral incompleteness banner (K14 NEW-2):** `.sig-incompleteness`
  drops the raspberry for `rule-strong`/`surface-2` — absence is not a
  disagreement; the bound-layer and speculative-path accents move off
  the reserved hue too.
- **New primitives:** the `.sig-provisional` chip (dashed amber outline
  + label) and `h1–h4`/`code`/`tabular-nums` coverage for the component
  kits (P36.22/23 consume; this row ships the layer).
- **No forked palettes:** `src/lib/design-tokens.ts` mirrors the data
  ramp for MapLibre style JSON (which takes literal colour strings);
  `map-tiles.ts` + `MapIsland.tsx` + `NetworkIsland.tsx` lose every
  hex/hsl literal — a unit test pins the TS constants byte-equal to the
  CSS tokens.
- **The gate (SIG-UI-146/156):** `scripts/check-tokens.mjs` —
  the stylelint-equivalent allow-list (no colour/font-size/space/
  radius/motion literals outside `tokens.css` and the enumerated
  exceptions) plus the wire budgets: every built css carrying `--sig-`
  ≤ 12 KiB gzip (epistemic bundle measured **5.23 KiB**), the woff2
  ≤ 30 KiB (**26.2 KiB**). Wired as `check:tokens` in `npm run check`.
- **Tests:** `design-tokens.test.ts` extended to 29 tests — green-band
  guard across all three contexts, alias-resolved hsl() parsing, the
  8-step scale, monotone ramp, reserved-hue usage, WCAG AA contrast on
  both schemes, reduced-motion/print posture, the TS-mirror pin, font
  budget; `inferred-marker.test.ts` reads the token from its new home;
  e2e `design-tokens.spec.ts` proves the rendered page flips to the
  chosen dark set, zeroes transitions under reduce, shows the banner
  neutral, and declares `color-scheme`.

## Deviations / deferrals

1. **The map focus ring is neutral ink, not the reserved amber.** The
   islands' orange focus/selection highlight collided with the amber
   band K14 reserves for Provisional — it now rides `--sig-ink` /
   `--sig-link`, and the selection keeps its non-colour channel (the
   ring shape + stroke width).
2. **Sub-step spacing rounds to the scale.** Legacy `0.1–0.9rem` gaps
   snapped to the 4 px ramp (the biggest visual delta: the `0.62rem`
   nav label becomes the 13 px floor `step--2` — the floor is the
   design, NEW-5); `margin: -1px` (visually-hidden) and `@page 2cm`
   stay as the allow-list's named exceptions.
3. **Dark ramp anchors flip, semantics don't.** On a dark surface the
   monotone direction inverts so "most support" stays the most
   contrasting step; the test asserts monotonicity in each context.
4. **Deferrals: +0/−0** — nothing unlandable; no live leg, no
   production mutation.

## Test plan

- Removing any token, literal-bypassing a colour/size/space/radius, or
  drifting the TS mirror off the CSS fails `check:tokens` or the unit
  suite — every new behaviour carries a fails-if-removed test.
- ADR-155: no route added or reclassified; T0 stays script-free, the
  T1 pages keep no-JS parity (the e2e sweeps pass unchanged), and the
  CSS grows inside the existing budgets.
